stem: An automobile of mass m accelerates, starting from rest, while the engine supplies constant power P. Show that: (a) the velocity is given as a function of time by v = (2Pt/m) 1/2 ; (b) the acceleration of the car is not constant but is given as a function of time by a = (P/2m) 1/2 t −1/2 ; (c) the position is given as a function of time by s = (8P/9m) 1/2 t 3/2 —

If the angle made by the radius vector of the ball with the vertical when the ball comes to an instantaneous rest is 60°, then the value of k is — (a) 9mg/(π²R) (b) 18mg/(π²R) (c) 36mg/(π²R) (d) 72mg/(π²R) —

Initially the spring makes an angle 37° with the horizontal as shown in the figure. A small bob A of mass m is attached to a massless rigid rod of length 1 m pivoted at point P and kept at an angle of 60° with the vertical. At a distance of 1 m below point P, an identical bob B is kept at rest on a smooth horizontal surface that extends to a circular track of radius R. If bob B just manages to complete the circular path of radius R up to a point Q after being hit elastically by bob A, then radius R is ____ m — (a) 3/5 (b) 1/5 (c) (2+√3)/5 (d) (2−√3)/5 (JEE Main 2026, 23rd Jan Shift 1, Level-5) — (PYQ)

Two blocks with masses 100 g and 200 g are attached to the ends of springs A and B respectively, as shown in the figure (each spring hangs from the ceiling with its block at the bottom). The energy stored in A is E. The energy stored in B, when the spring constants k A , k B of A and B respectively satisfy the relation 4k A = 3k B , is — (a) 4E (b) 2E (c) 3E (d) (4/3)E (JEE Main 2026, 23rd Jan Shift 1, Level-3) — (PYQ)

A 5 kg block is simply released from the top of an inclined plane as shown in the figure: it slides 10 m down a frictionless 30° incline (μ = 0), then travels 2 m along a horizontal stretch with μ = 0.5, and then hits a spring of constant k = 100 N/m. The maximum compression in the spring when the block hits the spring is — (a) √6 m (b) √5 m (c) 1 m (d) 2 m (JEE Main 2024, Level-5) — (PYQ)
